content.text: 16. REMOVE COMPRESSOR WITH BRACKET FROM CYLINDER BLOCK

items: (c) Lay the compressor with bracket to one side without disconnecting the hoses.

content.description: Illustration showing power steering pump removal from bracket

content.text: 17. REMOVE POWER STEERING PUMP FROM BRACKET

items: (a) Remove the PS pump pulley with no. 1 drive belt.
(b) Remove the three pressure and return line brackets.
(c) Disconnect the pressure and return lines.
(d) Remove the PS pump with stay.
(e) Remove the PS pump from bracket.

content.text: 28. REMOVE STIFFENER PLATE WITH GROUND STRAP

content.text: CAUTION: Catch leaking fuel in a container and plug the line.
